head_commit.message:
poll: Spend claude's weekly allowance until tomorrow's reset

The operator is using the rest of claude's allowance before it resets,
and the usage snapshot gives claude a 95-point burst for that. The poll
recomputes its own hold with a 5-point margin and holds claude anyway,
and with both pools in fixPools it would prefer openai, which is under
its pace. Until per-pool holds come from the snapshot (agent-board#233),
let fix rounds use claude only with a margin that matches its burst.

Revert both lines after the reset (fixPools back to claude and openai,
marginPercent back to 5).

Assisted-by: https://github.com/cgwalters/cgwalters#llms
